chunks: Al-Hasan al-Sayqal asked him about a man who said:
The first slave I acquire shall be free. Then he acquired six, so he said: His intention was only for one, so let him choose whichever of them he wishes and set him free.

key_terms.أَمْلِكُهُ: I come to own or acquire him as property

ai.seo_question: If someone vows that the first slave he acquires will be free, then acquires several slaves, which one must be emancipated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a conditional declaration of emancipation. When a man said the first slave he acquired would be free, then later acquired six, the ruling was that his intention applied to only one slave, so he may choose any one of them to emancipate.
